template:
<select id="findList" resultType="com.kairui.aimb.model.ai.menu.MenuVo">
        SELECT m.id,
        m.pid,
        m.name,
        m.url,
        m.icon,
        m.icon_selected,
        m.version,
        m.sort
        FROM ai_menu m
        WHERE m.id IN (SELECT mr.menu_id
        FROM ai_menu_role_relation mr
        WHERE mr.role = #{dto.role}
        <if test="dto.version == null">
            AND mr.version IS NULL
        </if>
        <if test="dto.version != null">
            AND mr.version = #{dto.version}
        </if>
        )
    </select>
